{{Quote|You see this pilot friend of yours had his hands in a lot of pockets, trying to get money where ever he could. For a while he was even shipping slaves for the Trandoshan's. I found out that they knew about his business with the Rebels and wanted him retired, permanently.|[[Wire]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Gc" />}}
'''Cal Handro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He is a merchant and on one of this runs, he disappeared! I can't imagine what happened! He's a very good pilot.|[[Tyla Jinn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Quest: "Man Down!"}}</ref>}}
Cal Handro was a smuggler without scruples who sided with both sides during the Galactic Civil War, trying to get money where ever he could. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he shipped [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers allied with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, Handro later switched sides when he discovered, thanks to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Wire]], that he was wanted dead by the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]], a rival Trandoshan clan. The slavemaster [[Trussk]] considered that Handro was interfering in their business.<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> The smuggler therefore went to work for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

[[File:Cal_Handro_crashed_ship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cal Handro's crashed ship on Rori.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Cal Handro was transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the Rebels in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] when his [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was shot down and cashed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. Handro survived to the crash but was attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] henchmen, forcing him to flee. The Black Sun had learnt the content of Handro's cargo and wanted to steal the spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> The smuggler successfully escaped the Black Sun and after a long walk in the wilderness and eventually arrived at the [[Martano estate]]. [[Tierce Martano]], an old [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] friend living on Rori, accepted to hide the pilot in a safe house nearby.<ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "Within Your Grasp"}}</ref>

The Rebel Alliance was indeed concerned by the disappearance of Cal Handro. When the pilot was reported missing, Officer [[Veega Madish]] soon assembled a team of Rebel operatives and sent them to Rori to search Handro's last known coordinates. Moreover, the crash of Handro's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] had been spoted by the Empire. Imperial Officer [[Jevan Monsul]] gathered a task force and ordered the Imperial agents to investigate the situation. Finally, one close friend of Handro by the name [[Tyla Jinn]] also realized that something went wrong after she lost contact with the pilot. She decided to recruit spacers and paid them to find Handro.<ref name="SWG:MD" />

[[File:MartanoEstate2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Black Sun enforcers besieging the Martano estate.]]
Some of those spacers managed to find the crash site of Cal Handro's ship, in the [[Madyn Plains]] of Rori. While some Black Sun thugs were still present in the area, the spacers did not find any trace of the pilot and only collected Handro's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a sample of spice. They later learnt that a woman known as [[Kaila Min]] spoted Cal Handro as he was escaping in the wilderness of Rori. The spacers rushed to the pilot's last known location, only to be attacked by Black Sun minions. From their attackers, they obtained the location of the [[Black Sun bunker|Black Sun base]] on Rori but did not find Handro there. The spacers later traveled to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and Naboo to investigate Cal Handro's relationships with Trandoshan slavers, but it was also a dead end.<ref name="SWG:Gc" />

In the meantime, the Black Sun finally discovered that Cal Handro took shelter at the Martano estate. While the criminals began besieging the building, Tierce Martano contacted both the Empire and the Rebel Alliance to negotiate information about the pilot. But before he could get an answer, he was rescued by the spacers who eliminated all Black Sun forces. As Martano wished to get rid of Handro, he eagerly accepted to give the location of Handro to the spacers.<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=Rebel Alliance}}
{{Quote|He's an old Sabacc buddy of mine and he knew that I had a house out here and I happened to be here when he asked to stay. However, this deal has been getting worse for me as it goes. He didn't warn me that he was going to be so well-liked..|[[Tierce Martano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WYG" />}}
Tierce Martano had established contact with Officer [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] for the Empire and [[Wolff Kalos]] for the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> Finally, the spacers decided to side with the Rebellion and contacted Kalos. The latter immediately sent agents to pick Cal Handro and transferred him to a [[Rebel Safe House]]. At this point, the man was considered as a traitor by the Rebellion for having smuggled slaves for the Empire. However, the Empire soon got the information and immediately dispatched a group of mercenary to attack the building. Although the spacers arrived rapidly to help the Rebel forces, the pilot used the diversion to escape with a group of Imperial agents. Handro accepted the help of the Empire and eventually left Rori aboard a [[Warlord Heavy Cruiser]].<ref name="SWG:FtA" />

[[File:Cal_Handro_Warlord_Heavy_Cruiser.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser.]]
While Cal Handro was about to leave the Naboo system, the Rebel spacers interrogated Officer M'Kae, Tierce Martano's Imperial contact, because they suspected him to be involved in Handro's escape. The Imperial officer eventually revealed that the wanted man was about to leave the system to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The spacers rushed to the nearest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and launched in space to intercept [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|Cal Handro's ship]]. Piloting their own [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the spacers attacked the Imperial [[Light cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and its escort. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was heavily armored and well armed but the Rebel forces eventually destroyed it, as well as its escort. Cal Handro died in the explosion of the ship.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}
{{Quote|We regret to inform you that your family member, Cal Handro, has been declared missing. At this time, we attepmting to clarify his status.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Vekker (sergeant)|Vekker]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:P14">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Loading Screen: "Publish 14"}}</ref>}}
During those events, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Vekker (sergeant)|Vekker]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] contacted the family of Cal Handro to inform them about the disappearance of the pilot.<ref name="SWG:P14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cal Handro appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Cal Handro was the main antagonist of the story arc "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]." He was mentioned upon the release of the first chapter of the questline, with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]" on [[March 9]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> but he only appeared in the game with the fourth chapter, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], 2005.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> For the first three chapters, the story was quite similar either the player was aligned with the Empire, the Rebel Alliance or neutral.<ref name="SWG:MD" /><ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /><ref name="SWG:Gc" /> However, in the fourth chapter, the player had to choose to side with the Empire or the Rebels.<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> The story diverged at this point since Cal Handro would always join the faction opposed to the player.<ref name="SWG:FtA" /><ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Empire!"</ref>

The fifth and final chapter of "Secrets of the Syren" was in development in [[October]] 2005<ref name="ID">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> and was planned to be introduced in [[April]] [[2006]] with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]."<ref name="P28">{{WebCite|url=https://forums.mmorpg.com/discussion/72650/pub-28-notes|text=Pub 28 Notes|date=2006-03-31|nobackup=1}}</ref> The player had to investigate whether Cal Handro had survived the destruction of his ship in the space battle.<ref name="SWG:SotSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Secrets of the Syren: Endgame|Talus}}</ref> However, the final chapter of "Secrets of the Syren" was never released.<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was finally removed from the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], 2006, due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
